description.narrative: The investment project will develop four new extension corridors comprising 43.8 km route length to further encourage modal shifts to low carbon public transport. The proposed corridors are mainly the extension of the Phase I corridors connecting the new and growing urban agglomerations of Nagpur City, including the proposed special economic zones, thereby providing public transport connectivity to the new urban areas in the city. The combined 83.8 km metro rail network is expected to cater to daily passenger trips of 590,000 by 2031 and 730,000 by 2041.
